coverage.limitation: Nonexhaustive seed set; lexical family/concept proxies within observed metadata/evidence, not universal completeness.

definitions.evidence_location_rate: Traceable page/section/abstract/offset location availability; not human correctness.
definitions.evidence_grounding_rate: Quote found at the recorded source location, not semantic entailment.
definitions.evidence_entailment_accuracy: Positive independently completed human entailment judgments / completed judgments.
definitions.human_location_accuracy: Correct human-reviewed locations / completed location judgments.
definitions.evidence_contradiction_detection_rate: Detected gold-positive contradictory claims / human-labelled contradictory claims.
definitions.unsupported_claim_rate: Human-labelled unsupported primary claims / independently labelled primary claims.
definitions.structurally_unsupported_claim_rate: Primary claim support missing from actual evidence / primary non-hypothesis claims.

limitations: No human judgments are inferred from LLM confidence.
Missing/empty independent labels produce null ratios.
Fixtures are excluded from scientific metric denominators.
